entries.jp: {v:0028}おい！{n}そいつらは俺たちが倒す！{n}街の中に下がっていろ！
entries.en: {v:0028}Hey! We'll take care of them! Fall back into town!

entries.jp: {v:0029}断る！{p}{v:002A}今まで殺された仲間の仇を討つ！
entries.en: {v:0029}I refuse!{p}{v:002A}I'll avenge all the comrades they've killed!

entries.jp: へっへっへっ‥‥。{n}今まで人を殺しすぎた罰が当たったのかな‥‥
entries.en: Heh heh heh... Guess this is what I get for killing so{n}many people...

entries.jp: くそっ！{n}こいつら、人を殺しなれてやがる‥‥
entries.en: Damn! These bastards are used to killing...

entries.jp: 正規兵の俺が、賊ごときに‥‥
entries.en: I'm a regular soldier... Beaten by mere bandits...

entries.jp: {v:0030}ああっ！{n}ランザックの兵隊さんがっ！
{v:0031}き、貴様ら！{n}よくも我が部下を！
entries.en: {v:0031}Y-you bastards! How dare you do that to{n}my subordinate!
{v:0032}N-no, you've got it wrong! This is...

entries.jp: {v:002C}やるじゃねぇか‥‥。{p}{v:002D}だが、まだやられるわけにはいかねぇんだよ！
entries.en: {v:002C}You're pretty good...{p}{v:002D}But I ain't going down yet!
